info.coinscoinscoins.coin_netherite:
Since Netherite doesn't burn, the only way to obtain coins from its nuggets is through compacting.

Drop a Netherite Nugget into the world, and make an Anvil block fall on it to compact it to a Netherite Coin.

Works on multiple items as well!
info.coinscoinscoins.coin_ancient:
Since Netherite doesn't burn, the only way to progress to the next tier is through compacting.

Drop a Netherite Coin Pile into the world, and make an Anvil block fall on it to compact it to an Ancient Coin.

Works on multiple items as well!
